title: Optimal approximation of smooth functions by ReLU neural networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.22693v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study uniform approximation of the H\"older ball $\mathcal H_1^s([0,1]^D)$ by fully connected ReLU networks. Except in the one-dimensional Lipschitz case, existing constructions remain separated from the information-theoretic efficiency limit. This article closes the gap for every $s>0$ and $D\ge1$: networks with width $O(N)$, depth $O(L)$, and parameter magnitude $O(1)$ attain uniform approximation error of order $(N^2L^2\log N)^{-s/D}$. No relation between width and depth is required. The construction uses new encoding and decoding mechanisms that exploit higher-order finite-difference bounds for local Taylor coefficients of the target function. As a statistical consequence, empirical risk minimizers over the corresponding clipped network classes attain the minimax regression rate $n^{-2s/(2s+D)}$ without additional logarithmic factors. translated_title: ReLU神经网络对光滑函数的最优逼近
translated_abstract: 我们研究了全连接ReLU网络对Hölder球 $\mathcal H_1^s([0,1]^D)$ 的一致逼近问题。除了一维Lipschitz情形外，现有构造与信息论效率极限之间仍存在差距。本文对任意 $s>0$ 和 $D\ge1$ 完全弥合了这一差距：宽度为 $O(N)$、深度为 $O(L)$、参数幅值为 $O(1)$ 的网络可达到 $(N^2L^2\log N)^{-s/D}$ 阶的一致逼近误差，且无需对宽度和深度之间的关系作任何假设。该构造采用了新的编码与解码机制，利用目标函数局部泰勒系数的高阶有限差分界。作为统计上的推论，在相应截断网络类上的经验风险最小化器可以达到极小极大回归速率 $n^{-2s/(2s+D)}$，且不含额外的对数因子。论文还对关键的逼近技术进行了详细阐述，涵盖……
tldr: 本文证明了宽度为O(N)、深度为O(L)的ReLU网络对任意光滑度s和维度D下的Hölder函数类均能达到最优逼近误差$(N^2L^2\log N)^{-s/D}$，并由此导出无额外对数因子的极小极大回归速率。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that ReLU networks with width O(N) and depth O(L) achieve the optimal uniform approximation error $(N^2L^2\log N)^{-s/D}$ for Hölder smooth functions for all smoothness s and dimension D, yielding the minimax regression rate without additional logarithmic factors.
